title: Business Trend Monitor
subtitle: Replacing constant dashboard checks with alerts when something needs attention.

evidence.statement: Multi-brand summaries about every three hours

quickView.problem: As monitoring grew, more people had to repeatedly check dashboards across brands.
quickView.evolution: Manual check → browser helper → automated dashboard → audio alerts → Slack alerts
quickView.product: A monitoring workflow that stays quiet when healthy and interrupts when attention is needed.
quickView.impact: Automated monitoring surfaces urgent issues quickly and replaces constant manual dashboard checking.
quickView.learning: Monitor continuously. Stay quiet when healthy. Interrupt only when something deserves attention.
